name: page-bundle
description: The files a web page ships and what they say about it without running them: stack, routes, source modules, keys, storage, design tokens, motion, fonts, and assets. Never cached.

verbs.name: fetch
verbs.description: Download a page's HTML, same-origin scripts and stylesheets, the chunks they import, and their source maps into the data home, then read them. Prints the stack, one entry per line, or the bundle with --json.

verbs.name: parse
verbs.description: Read a page bundle from a folder already on disk. The folder holds index.html and the files it loads, at the paths the page names.

dir.description: Folder with index.html at its root.
